chapter: Paris, Lester Young, drugs, Mississippi and later sessions
title: Recent work with Neal Hefti and Billy May
summary: Collins played with Neal Hefti's new band and recorded for Capitol with Billy May.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: I see some more notes of yours. What

have you got written down there? Well, I want to mention the fact that I did work with Neal Hefti quite a bit this past summer. He had a band, he formed another band. He got the yen to conduct again, and that was quite a pleasure. We worked Disney band and quite a few casuals, and Nat Pierce was the pianist. And Frankie Capp was drummer, and it was a very good band, any way. And I did quite a bit of recording with Billy May. Now, the -- here we go again.
I don't remember what they were, you know. But I also --
Do you know what label? Capitol?
